n303ff5e4a6.headline: How to book an apartment among a quarter of a million units offered by the state for youth and low-income people?.. Details
n303ff5e4a6.summary: Egypt's Ministry of Housing intends to offer about 250,000 housing units for booking during the 2020-2021 fiscal year targeting youth and low-income people.
n303ff5e4a6.why: Large-scale housing initiatives impact the real estate market and social economic conditions in Egypt.
